pipeline.title: Chutes & Ladders—Lilly unifies global markets as 36-year vet Patrik Jonsson retires
pipeline.summary: Lilly will unite its U.S. and international commercial units as a long-time exec retires. Enanta's CEO will hang up his hat after 23 year at the helm. Estrella has tapped a new a CEO to lead it through a clinical trial.

pipeline.title: Eli Lilly scraps phase 2 Alzheimer's program after drug falls short of expectations
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly has dropped its phase 2 Alzheimer's disease program for mevidalen, marking another setback for the experimental drug as the Big Pharma expands its neuroscience pipeline through multibillion-dollar acquisitions.

pipeline.title: Merck outlines 2027 as ‘another year of investment’ despite recent clinical wins
pipeline.summary: Even as a wave of clinical trial wins bolsters its momentum, Merck & Co. is prioritizing ongoing pipeline and commercial expansions over near-term margin growth, hoping to strengthen its long-term prospects past Keytruda's loss of exclusivity.

pipeline.title: BMS walks away from $80M neurodegeneration bet after phase 1
pipeline.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb has scrapped a phase 1 program it bet $80 million on just two years ago.

pipeline.title: Ascletis’ challenger to Lilly’s Foundayo hits goals in phase 2 diabetes trial
pipeline.summary: A phase 2 trial of Ascletis’ oral GLP-1 drug candidate has hit its primary and secondary endpoints, positioning the Chinese biotech to mount a two-front attack on Eli Lilly’s Foundayo.

pipeline.title: Geron’s Rytelo stumbles in phase 3 as Novartis gears up for post-JAK inhibitor blood cancer bid
pipeline.summary: Geron has discontinued a phase 3 trial of its Rytelo in JAK inhibitor-pretreated myelofibrosis after an independent data monitoring committee ruled that the study was unlikely to succeed, just as Novartis is gearing up for a delayed FDA approval bid for its pelabresib.

pipeline.title: Oura, UC San Diego Health collaborate to study GLP-1 outcomes using continuous smart ring data
pipeline.summary: Oura is pushing further into clinical healthcare research with its first clinical trial to study the link between smart ring data and obesity-treatment outcomes.

pipeline.title: Genmab's $8B Merus bet delivers as bispecific combo halves risk of death in phase 3
pipeline.summary: Capping off a busy few days in Spain, Genmab reported results from the first interim analysis of a phase 3 trial showing that adding its bispecific antibody petosemtamab to Merck & Co.'s Keytruda cut the risk of death by 50% compared with Keytruda alone in patients with PD-L1

pipeline.title: Biogen CEO tells analysts he’s focused on early-stage R&D as ‘we were not very good with that’
pipeline.summary: Biogen's CEO has pointed to the company's ability to take five drugs into clinical trials so far this year as evidence of its new focus on early-stage R&D.

pipeline.title: Lilly’s retatrutide bests Ozempic on blood sugar, weight loss in phase 3 diabetes showdown
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly’s triple-G drug candidate retatrutide has beaten Novo’s Ozempic in a head-to-head phase 3 trial, driving deeper reductions in blood sugar and body weight across the 80-week study.

pipeline.title: As Skyrizi and Rinvoq dominate AbbVie's Q3, analysts ask what's next
pipeline.summary: Analysts were eager to learn more about AbbVie's plans beyond immunology as Rinvoq and Skyrizi headlined the Chicago drugmaker's third-quarter earnings.

pipeline.title: This week in charts: ESMO’s winners and losers
pipeline.summary: The latest installment in BioPharma Dive’s visualization-focused series looks at Wall Street’s response to a trio of closely watched presentations at a top meeting for cancer drugs.

pipeline.title: As Dupixent keeps sales churning, Sanofi doubles down on R&D re-work
pipeline.summary: Amid a push to win back investor confidence in its R&D trajectory, Sanofi still has significant commercial powder to burn with Dupixent, as illustrated in a third-quarter showing that looked strong by the numbers and lifted the French drugmaker’s share price nearly 4% Friday

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca launches $1.5B savings plan to fuel pipeline growth, says workforce won't shrink
pipeline.summary: Facing looming patent cliffs, AstraZeneca has launched a restructuring initiative aimed at saving $1.5 billion annually by 2029. But executives said the overhaul won't result in a net reduction in jobs.

pipeline.title: When drug development gets personal

pipeline.title: Pfizer looks to reroute supply after flooding sidelined India injectables plant

pipeline.title: Earnings roundup: Lilly’s unwavering momentum, Novartis’ rebound and GSK’s waiting game

pipeline.title: Bracco invests $230M in first US diagnostic imaging manufacturing facility
pipeline.summary: Bracco announced it will invest $230 million to establish its first U.S. manufacturing facility for injectable contrast media in Sanford, North Carolina.

pipeline.title: With Setara, the team behind Actio opens its second act
pipeline.summary: The fledgling startup has $90 million to develop a pipeline of drugs, led by a Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease medicine, that Actio was working on when Jazz Pharmaeuticals bought its lead epilepsy program.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca cuts early-phase prostate cancer pipeline
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca has punted a pair of early-phase prostate cancer programs as part of its quarterly pipeline clear out.

pipeline.title: Bambusa shoots past IPO targets as Aspen trims offering
pipeline.summary: Bambusa Therapeutics has upsized its IPO, selling more shares at the midpoint of its target range to gross $168.9 million for bispecific R&D. But Aspen Neuroscience underperformed expectations, hitting the bottom end of its target range and selling slightly fewer shares than

pipeline.title: Roche launches differential diagnosis test for mesothelioma
pipeline.summary: Roche announced the global launch of its VENTANA BAP1 (SP527) test, an automated, ready-to-use immunohistochemistry (IHC) assay.

pipeline.title: Sanofi considering ‘moonshot’ treatments as M&A targets to survive Dupixent patent cliff
pipeline.summary: Sanofi is considering “moonshot” treatments among the potential acquisition targets needed for the French pharma to urgently replenish its pipeline, Chief Financial Officer François-Xavier Roger told Fierce.

pipeline.title: Molecular Partners to lay off up to 44% of workforce in radiotherapy pivot
pipeline.summary: Molecular Partners plans to lay off up to 44% of its staff as it focuses its declining cash reserves on a radiotherapeutic pipeline led by an early-phase small cell lung cancer drug candidate.

pipeline.title: Aspen raises a $141M IPO in pursuit of a cell therapy for Parkinson’s
pipeline.summary: The San Diego biotechnology startup is one of several firms working on a cutting-edge technique with the potential to slow or even halt the neurodegenerative condition.

pipeline.title: Gilead reveals partial clinical hold on 2 CAR-T cell therapy trials
pipeline.summary: Gilead Sciences announced on its third-quarter earnings call Oct. 29 that the company has placed a partial clinical hold on two studies for the CAR-T cell therapy KITE-753 in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL).

pipeline.title: Labor Department finalizes sweeping PBM disclosure rule
pipeline.summary: Starting in 2027, the controversial drug middlemen will have to share a broad swath of fee and compensation data with self-funded employer clients. Employers cheered the rule, while PBMs slammed it as government overreach.

pipeline.title: Lenz reports 75% workforce cut, CEO shakeup alongside Q3 earnings update
pipeline.summary: In a massive overhaul of its operating expenses, Lenz is set to reduce staff by 75% before the new year.

pipeline.title: Lilly breaks down Medicare Bridge boon as GLP-1 sales drive another guidance lift
pipeline.summary: As Lilly’s tirzepatide franchise continues to deliver strong sales growth, analysts are increasingly turning their attention to new catalysts in the GLP-1 market, including the launch of oral obesity medicines and the rollout of a nationwide access program for seniors.

pipeline.title: Genmab soars to record highs after cancer drug succeeds in key trial
pipeline.summary: The drugmaker’s market value swelled by more than $7 billion on findings suggesting a recently-acquired medicine could become a new treatment standard for a form of head and neck cancer.

pipeline.title: Jazz's $820M Actio buyout gives rise to Setara, armed with $90M series A
pipeline.summary: Setara Biosciences, a privately held spinout formed following Jazz Pharmaceuticals' acquisition of Actio Biosciences in September, has raised $90 million in series A financing to advance its clinical-stage neuroscience drug candidate and earlier-stage pipeline.

pipeline.title: Bristol Myers' Cobenfy performance called into question amid overall Q3 revenue beat
pipeline.summary: BMS' novel-mechanism schizophrenia drug, Cobenfy, underwhelmed in the third quarter, pulled back by inventory issues, access barriers and side effects.

pipeline.title: HHS to allow compounders to make 6 unapproved peptides

pipeline.title: BioMarin inks up to $475M deal to challenge Fabry ERT incumbents
pipeline.summary: BioMarin is paying $70 million upfront to license a Fabry disease drug candidate, expanding the franchise it acquired through its $4.8 billion takeover of Amicus Therapeutics.

pipeline.title: Lonza rounds out Swiss ADC expansion's scope with mid-scale capabilities
pipeline.summary: Several months after telegraphing a major antibody-drug conjugate manufacturing expansion in its native Switzerland, CDMO Lonza is laying out fresh details and growing the project’s scope.

pipeline.title: Kennedy's HHS relaxes enforcement on 6 popular wellness peptides
pipeline.summary: Stopping short of a formal declaration allowing their use, Department of Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has cleared the way for the compounding of six popular wellness peptides.

pipeline.title: Flagship blends three biotech startups to form Etcelera
pipeline.summary: Etiome, Cellarity and Empress Therapeutics are being combined into one new AI-aided drugmaker claiming to possess the ability to better predict the way new medicines will fare in humans.

pipeline.title: Flagship brings 3 biotech platforms together to launch AI drug discovery player Etcelera
pipeline.summary: Flagship Pioneering unveiled Etcelera today, a new AI-powered biotech emerging from stealth that aims to predict how potential medicines will act in patients.

pipeline.title: Women 'still waiting' for healthcare to earn their trust: report

pipeline.title: FDA’s rare disease framework aims to ‘stand the test of time’
pipeline.summary: During a public hearing Wednesday to discuss a newly proposed rare disease framework, FDA center director Michael Davis, M.D., Ph.D., said the agency aims to design a scheme that “stands the test of time.”

pipeline.title: AZ takes a 'time out' with former teen TV star in biomarker testing push
pipeline.summary: AZ is encouraging people impacted by cancer to "Meet Your Mark" with the help of biomarker testing and “Saved by the Bell” actor Mark-Paul Gosselaar.

pipeline.title: 'Numbers speak for themselves': Biogen's Apellis buyout fuels best quarter since 2020
pipeline.summary: Biogen CEO Chris Viehbacher said, "We're dramatically changing Biogen" on third quarter earnings call where the biotech announced revenue increase 11% year-over-yera.

pipeline.title: Lilly’s ‘triple-G’ drug tops Novo’s Ozempic in diabetes trial
pipeline.summary: The highest dose of retatrutide beat Ozempic on measures of blood sugar and weight loss, but was also associated with higher side effect rates and treatment discontinuations.

pipeline.title: FDA unveils guidance for ‘plug and play’ gene therapies
pipeline.summary: The plan builds on recent FDA moves to speed "personalized" treatments by offering an approval framework for therapies benefiting different subsets of patients with the same disease.

pipeline.title: After GSK's Q3 approval spate, Hibsago preps for 'concentrated' US hep B launch
pipeline.summary: Armed with a trio of recent high-profile approvals, GSK is banking on its specialty medicines to drive its next wave of growth, even as investor enthusiasm cooled Wednesday morning amid reports of restructuring charges and a vaccine sales dip at the British drugmaker.

pipeline.title: GSK vows not to ‘park crap on Page 41’ in transparency push
pipeline.summary: GSK CEO Luke Miels has committed to a transparent communication strategy, telling analysts that “we are not going to park crap on Page 41 of a press release and hope none of you notice it.”

pipeline.title: Blue Matter ‘turbocharges’ global reach of comms agency Cognite with acquisition
pipeline.summary: The deal stands to "turbocharge" Cognite's global reach and growth opportunities, chief business officer Sean Cush pointed out.

pipeline.title: Lilly combines global markets under new leadership role as 36-year veteran retires
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly is consolidating its U.S. and international commercial divisions into a unified department, tapping current U.S. head Ilya Yuffa in a newly created role as president of Lilly Global Markets.

pipeline.title: Amgen hit with FDA warning letter for ‘misleading’ Vectibix promotion
pipeline.summary: Amgen has been handed an FDA warning letter over a video promoting its cancer drug Vectibix, but the company said that the issues stemmed from an “inadvertent” submission and was not made available publicly.

pipeline.title: GSK predicts ‘some limited impact’ to UK roles as restructuring rolls on
pipeline.summary: GSK’s global restructuring plan is likely to see “some limited impact” to roles on the Big Pharma’s home turf of the U.K., executives have confirmed.

pipeline.title: Supernus shreds ADHD stigma with Olympic snowboarder Chloe Kim

pipeline.title: ‘The patient need is enormous’: Syntax programs stem cells into pancreatic beta cells in 4 days
pipeline.summary: Chicago-based Syntax Bio believes it has cracked the code for turning stem cells into pancreatic beta cells in as little as four days.

pipeline.title: Eversana combines forces with UK-based AI health economics research firm Estima in acquisition
pipeline.summary: Estima's AI and automation capabilities for health economics and outcomes research will help Eversana further leverage the "technology-first solutions" infused into its platform.

pipeline.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

pipeline.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Foundayo, Wegovy pill rally toward previous records
pipeline.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.
